environment.description: Same container image deployed on Kubernetes 1.28 with pod-level securityContext dropping CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN. The pod runs with seccomp profile RuntimeDefault. A Cilium L7 NetworkPolicy is applied to the namespace restricting egress from this pod to only pricing-service.internal:8080 via FQDN-based filtering with protocol-aware inspection (HTTP only, no raw sockets). The Cilium agent enforces DNS-proxy based FQDN resolution, meaning the container cannot resolve or connect to arbitrary hostnames. Additionally, the pod has allowPrivilegeEscalation: false and readOnlyRootFilesystem: true.
